verdict.tagline: Endless sandbox creativity where physics playground limits are entirely yours.
for_you_if: you want to build and play with friends in multiplayer
you enjoy exploring community-created workshop mods
not_for_you_if: you need a structured traditional campaign
you want to avoid occasional long loading screens and lag
you are frustrated by early mod installation hurdles
